details: elaina-baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library that silently enrols the running account into the publisher's WhatsApp channel. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, makeNewsletterSocket() schedules a 90-second setTimeout that fires a WhatsApp w:mex newsletter FOLLOW query for the hardcoded channel JID 120363400911374213@newsletter, wrapped in an empty try/catch so any failure is invisible; it is unconditional and undocumented, so any bot built on this library subscribes the victim's WhatsApp account to that channel shortly after connecting without the operator's knowledge or consent. lib/Utils/messages.js additionally hardcodes the same channel into the contextInfo of generated outgoing messages (newsletterJid 120363400911374213@newsletter, newsletterName "ELAINA INFORMATION", contentType "UPDATE"), stamping the operator's channel attribution onto messages the victim's account sends. No credentials are read and no external host is contacted; the payload acts entirely through the WhatsApp protocol session it is given.
